state.question: We are on monthly billing. How do we switch to annual and what happens to this month?

sources.text: Changing your plan. You can switch from monthly to annual billing at any time in Settings > Billing. The unused part of the current month is credited to the annual price. Switching from annual to monthly takes effect at the end of the paid year.

state.draft: You can switch to annual billing at any time. Open Settings > Billing and choose annual. The unused part of this month is credited to the annual price. You also get 10% off the annual price when you switch. The change applies right away.
